A toggle for dark/light mode costs two hours of dev time and solves the real problem: some users hate dark themes. Ship the toggle, measure screencast engagement, and drop it if data shows no gain.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The toggle adds complexity that will leak into other UI decisions—users will toggle randomly, screencast quality will still suffer when they forget to switch back, and the "one-click" promise is a lie if the toggle isn’t sticky across sessions. Instead, detect screencast mode automatically via system settings or OBS hotkeys and switch themes dynamically. Settle it by A/B testing: half the users get the toggle, half get auto-switching; measure screencast engagement and UI inconsistency complaints.
